---
title: "WNBA Leaders"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

games <- read_csv("data/wnba_player_games.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: points-vs-rebounds-plot
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

games |>
  mutate(position_name = case_when(
    position == "G" ~ "Guards",
    position == "F" ~ "Forwards",
    position == "C" ~ "Centers"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rebounds, y = points, color = position_name)) +
  # Jitter slightly to separate overlapping whole numbers
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, size = 1.2, width = 0.3, height = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Linear trend line showing the relationship within each position
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "black", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ position_name) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Points vs. Rebounds in WNBA Games by Position (2023–2024)",
    subtitle = "Each dot represents one player in a single game (9,902 games total). Dashed line shows the trend.",
    x = "Rebounds Grabbed in Game",
    y = "Points Scored in Game",
    caption = "Source: SportsDataverse (wehoop)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )
```
